root_causes.name: Database or schema dropped (audit trail)
root_causes.description: A DROP DATABASE / DROP SCHEMA (SQL Server) or DROP PLUGGABLE DATABASE / DROP TABLESPACE (Oracle) was recorded in the audit trail within the last 24 hours.
root_causes.resolution: Confirm the drop was authorised (change ticket). If not, isolate the principal, revoke its privileges, and restore the database/schema from backup. Verify the audit policy still captures DDL.

expected.description: A database/schema drop is present in the audit trail (last 24h).

detect.sqlserver:
SELECT TOP 500 CAST(GETDATE() AS DATETIME) AS event_time, s.login_name AS login_name,
       DB_NAME(r.database_id) AS database_name, CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS object_name,
       CAST(qt.text AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) AS statement
FROM sys.dm_exec_requests AS r WITH (NOLOCK)
JOIN sys.dm_exec_sessions AS s WITH (NOLOCK) ON s.session_id = r.session_id
OUTER APPLY sys.dm_exec_sql_text(r.sql_handle) AS qt
WHERE s.session_id <> @@SPID AND ISNULL(s.login_name,'') NOT LIKE '%dbdome%'
  AND qt.text IS NOT NULL AND (qt.text LIKE '%DROP%DATABASE%' OR qt.text LIKE '%DROP%SCHEMA%')
UNION ALL
SELECT TOP 500 qs.last_execution_time AS event_time, CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS login_name,
       DB_NAME(st.dbid) AS database_name, CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS object_name,
       CAST(st.text AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) AS statement
FROM sys.dm_exec_query_stats AS qs WITH (NOLOCK)
OUTER APPLY sys.dm_exec_sql_text(qs.sql_handle) AS st
WHERE qs.last_execution_time >= DATEADD(DAY,-1, GETDATE())
  AND st.text IS NOT NULL AND st.text NOT LIKE '%dm_exec_query_stats%'
  AND (st.text LIKE '%DROP%DATABASE%' OR st.text LIKE '%DROP%SCHEMA%')
detect.oracle:
SELECT event_timestamp AS event_time, dbusername AS login_name, object_schema AS database_name, object_name, sql_text AS statement
FROM unified_audit_trail
WHERE event_timestamp > SYSTIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '1' DAY
  AND (action_name IN ('DROP PLUGGABLE DATABASE','DROP TABLESPACE') OR UPPER(sql_text) LIKE '%DROP DATABASE%')
ORDER BY event_timestamp DESC FETCH FIRST 500 ROWS ONLY

root_causes.name: Table dropped (audit trail)
root_causes.description: A DROP TABLE statement was recorded in the audit trail within the last 24 hours, on any table.
root_causes.resolution: Confirm the table drop was authorised. If not, restore the table from backup or a recycle-bin/flashback, identify the principal, and review its DDL privileges.

root_causes.resolution: Confirm the account/role drop was authorised (de-provisioning ticket). If not, recreate the principal and its grants from your IAM baseline, and investigate the actor.

root_causes.name: Data deleted from a table (audit trail)
root_causes.description: A DELETE or TRUNCATE TABLE statement was recorded in the audit trail within the last 24 hours, on any table.
root_causes.resolution: Confirm the deletion was authorised. If not, restore affected rows from backup / flashback / point-in-time, identify the principal, and review DML privileges and WHERE-clause controls.

expected.description: A DELETE/TRUNCATE is present in the audit trail (last 24h).
